label: religious register context
explanation: This feature fires on function words, punctuation, and occasional content words when they occur in religious/theological passages, not on the words themselves; the strongest firings are in dense religious prose, especially after "God" (7% vs 0.2% baseline) and on religious actions like worship/deliver. It stays silent in ordinary non-religious text, and weak firings are spillover onto nearby function words in adjacent historical or formal prose.
